path.description: Any local `.java` file in the target workspace. This path is used to infer the workspace root and locate JDTLS. Absolute paths need no `workdir`; a relative path requires one.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory on the target daemon's file system, used only to resolve a relative `path` or `target`. Required when the given path is relative; never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

target.description: A raw `jdt://` URI, a workspace symbol output line, or a `file://` / `.class` path. Prefer a `jdt://` URI or an absolute class path; a relative class path requires an explicit `workdir` and fails without one.
